title: Coproducts of flat module sheaves are flat
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$, and let $\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O)$ be the category of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. If $(\mathcal M_b)_{b\in B}$ is a set-indexed family of flat sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], then the coproduct $\coprod_{b\in B}\mathcal M_b$ in $\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O)$ is flat over $\mathcal O$.

source.place: Lemma 18.28.5 (Tag 03EU), clause (2), direct sums of flat sheaves of modules are flat
